$comment: AI visual review (pnpm a11y:visual) — advisory: a person confirms findings and records the review with pnpm a11y:review.

answers.reason: No state or meaning shown by color alone. Icons (+, X, download, person) and focus ring provide meaning.
Blue button has strong contrast against light and dark backgrounds. White icons and focus ring are clearly distinguishable.
Icon-only buttons with no visible text labels. Criterion about visible text matching accessible name doesn't apply.
No text content to be clipped or truncated.
Visible blue focus ring around button in all focused screenshots (Default, Speed Dial, Expanded) clearly indicates keyboard focus.
